Based on the three views provided, here is a description of the room and answers to your questions.

### Description

This is a single, rectangular room with a formal and symmetrical layout. The floor is a striking black-and-white checkerboard pattern, with a large circular mosaic in the center featuring a gold or yellow sunburst/star design. The walls are a light tan or beige, possibly stone or plaster, with dark wooden vertical beams. Several of the wall panels feature simple arched windows or niches.

The room is furnished with simple wooden objects. At the far end, opposite the entrance, is a raised stone dais with a wooden altar or lectern. Behind this, mounted on the wall, is a wooden fixture that looks like a cabinet or a triptych. The main body of the room is filled with four rows of simple wooden benches, or pews, arranged in two sets on either side of a central aisle, all facing the altar.

In the back-left corner, a large, round wooden object, perhaps a decorative shield or a tabletop, is propped against the wall. In the back-right corner stands a tall, thin wooden object, possibly a candelabra or a banner stand. The entrance is a wide, open archway with no visible door.

***

### Questions

**(1) What kind of room is this, in a few words, and how sure are you?**

*   **What it is:** A small chapel or shrine.
*   **Confidence:** I am very confident. The combination of pews facing a central altar, the symmetrical and formal layout, and the arched niches are all classic elements of a place of worship.

**(2) What are its main things and where do they stand?**

*   **Altar/Lectern:** This is at the far end of the room (north), centered on a raised stone platform.
*   **Pews/Benches:** Four rows of them occupy the middle of the room, with two on the left and two on the right, creating a central aisle leading to the altar.
*   **Central Floor Mosaic:** A circular, sun-like emblem is set into the checkerboard floor directly in the center of the room.
*   **Round Shield/Table:** A large, round wooden object is propped against the wall in the back-left (north-west) corner.
*   **Tall Stand:** A tall, thin wooden object stands in the back-right (north-east) corner.

**(3) Is there one thing the room is built around?**

Yes, absolutely. The entire room is built around the **altar at the far end**. The symmetry of the room, the central aisle, the direction the pews are facing, and the raised platform all work together to make it the undeniable focal point.

**(4) What looks wrong, if anything?**

Based on what is visible in the images, here are a few potential issues:

*   **Floating:** The large, round wooden object (shield/table) in the back-left corner appears to be floating slightly. Its bottom edge doesn't seem to be resting on the floor in the three-quarter views (view-1 and view-2).
*   **Clipping:** That same round object in the back-left also appears to be clipping into the vertical wooden beam of the wall behind it.
*   **Unreadable at this distance:** The object on the wall behind the altar is difficult to identify clearly; it could be a cabinet, a carving, or a folded screen. Similarly, the tall object in the back-right corner is indistinct and hard to identify with certainty.
